item.title: Contractors & Trades
item.description:
You’re on a ladder or a job site all day. Calls go to voicemail, quote requests sit for days, and the customer books someone else.

What we set up

  • A website with a project gallery, service area map and a quote form that asks for photos up front
  • A Google Business Profile that shows up when homeowners nearby search for your trade
  • An AI front desk that answers calls and texts, gathers job details and books estimates
  • Automatic review requests when a job wraps up

The goal

More quote requests, faster replies, and fewer leads lost while your hands are full.

item.title: Junk Removal & Hauling
item.description:
People who need junk gone want it gone today. They call two or three companies and go with whoever responds first.

What we set up

  • Instant text-back for every missed call
  • A “send us a photo, get a price range” flow on your website and by text
  • Online booking for pickup windows that drops straight into your calendar
  • Local search setup so you show up across every neighborhood you serve

The goal

Be the first to answer, every time — even on the road.

item.title: Cleaning Services
item.description:
Cleaning businesses live on repeat customers and referrals — and lose hours every week to scheduling texts and quote back-and-forth.

What we set up

  • A website with clear packages and an instant quote form (bedrooms, bathrooms, frequency)
  • Online booking and automatic reminders that cut down on no-shows
  • An AI assistant that answers “Do you bring supplies?” and “Do you do move-outs?” for you
  • Review requests after every clean to keep your rating strong

The goal

A fuller calendar of recurring clients with less time spent on your phone.

item.title: Local Shops & Studios
item.description:
Local shops win on community and personality — but online, they’re competing with big-box stores and marketplaces.

What we set up

  • A website upgrade that shows off your store, events and what makes you different
  • Google and Apple Maps listings with up-to-date hours, photos and products
  • AI money tracking: log cash and card sales by photo or text, get a weekly cash-flow picture
  • Event and new-arrival posts that keep regulars coming back

The goal

More walk-ins from nearby searches, and a clear view of where your money goes.
